headline: One picture, 2 different works
reasons: The same picture was saved as 2 different files and attached to 2 different works in 2 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 2 separate works.

The 2 files hold one picture saved more than once (for example re-compressed, resized, cut by a few pixels or with another date or GPS stamp printed on it), so their bytes differ. They were matched by comparing the pictures: every two of these files differ in at most 7 of 256 bits of a picture fingerprint (the limit is 8), and their small greyscale copies differ by at most 0.025 (the limit is 0.03).
The files (first 12 characters of each fingerprint): 1049f3c9ec96 on 1 work, 15d9e3577f14 on 1 work.
The works are recorded as: Other (2).
These works are spread over 2 blocks: Duggirala, Kollipara.
